column3: *Gist:* Indra answers: ... that is why I go quickly and alone.
column4: (no Gist in the Kannada; the Kannada bhāvārtha and the closing "ಅತೋಽಸಹಾಯ ಇತಿ ಮಂತವ್ಯಮಿತಿ ಭಾವಃ" say nothing of "quickly")
column5: The English adds a summary "Gist" with "Indra answers" and "I go quickly", which has nothing behind it in the Kannada (only the sense "alone" is there).
